customer_description: Chair makes loud squeaking sound when I lean back. Started about 2 weeks ago. Very annoying during meetings.
agent_resolution: Identified loose screw set S-4012-SCRW under base P-9913-BASE. Instructed customer to tighten 4 screws to 12.5 Nm torque using 5mm hex key. Issue resolved.
resolution_steps: Turn chair upside down on protective surface | Locate screw set S-4012-SCRW (4 screws) securing base P-9913-BASE | Tighten all 4 screws to 12.5 Nm torque using 5mm hex key | Test recline motion for noise

customer_description: Chair slowly sinks down throughout the day. Have to pump it up every hour. Gas lift seems broken.
agent_resolution: Diagnosed gas lift cylinder C-7721-GL internal seal failure. Shipped replacement cylinder C-7721-GL. Customer replaced following guide: remove base bolts B-3301-BLT, swap cylinder, reassemble.
resolution_steps: Remove base P-9913-BASE by unscrewing 5 bolts B-3301-BLT | Extract gas lift cylinder C-7721-GL from column | Replace with new cylinder C-7721-GL | Reassemble in reverse order, torque bolts B-3301-BLT to 15 Nm

customer_description: Desk shows error E02 on control panel. Won't move up or down. Tried unplugging for a minute but error comes back.
agent_resolution: Error E02 indicates control box CB-2201-CTL fault. Shipped replacement control box. Customer swapped unit and re-paired Bluetooth app.
resolution_steps: Unplug all cables from control box CB-2201-CTL | Unmount control box from desk frame | Install replacement control box CB-2201-CTL | Reconnect all motor and sensor cables | Re-pair with mobile app via Bluetooth

customer_description: Left side of desk lags behind right side. Desk gets crooked when raising. Makes grinding noise on left side.
agent_resolution: Left spindle SP-4402-SPND binding. Instructed customer to lubricate with PTFE grease GR-9901-GRS and run calibration. If persistent, replace spindle.
resolution_steps: Lower desk fully | Apply PTFE grease GR-9901-GRS to left spindle SP-4402-SPND threads | Run calibration: hold DOWN button 10 seconds until CAL appears | Test full up/down cycle for even movement

customer_description: Right monitor slowly tilts downward over the course of the day. Have to readjust every morning. Monitor weighs about 7kg.
agent_resolution: Gas spring GS-9901-GSP losing pressure on right arm. 7kg is within 2-9kg range but spring may be defective. Shipped replacement GS-9901-GSP. Customer replaced pivot bolts PT-1101-PVT at same time.
resolution_steps: Support monitor weight while working | Remove pivot bolts PT-1101-PVT (M6) on right arm | Swap gas spring GS-9901-GSP | Reinstall pivot bolts PT-1101-PVT with blue thread locker, torque 5 Nm | Adjust tension knob KN-2201-KNB for monitor weight

customer_description: E key on left half registering double presses. Makes typing very difficult. Tried cleaning with air but no change.
agent_resolution: Switch SW-2201-SWT (Cherry MX Brown) on E key showing chatter. Firmware v2.3+ has improved debounce. Advised firmware update first, then switch replacement if needed.
resolution_steps: Update firmware to v2.4.1 via USB | Test E key for chatter | If persistent: remove keycap with KP-1101-PUL | Desolder switch SW-2201-SWT, solder replacement | Test with firmware debounce enabled

customer_description: Right half of keyboard randomly disconnects. LED flashes red. Have to unplug/replug TRRS cable to reconnect. Happens 3-4 times per day.
agent_resolution: Wireless module WM-4401-WLS on right half showing intermittent connectivity. Battery BT-7701-BAT also tested low. Replaced both wireless module and battery on right half.
resolution_steps: Test with wired TRRS cable CB-3301-CBL to isolate wireless | Right half fails wireless, works wired | Desolder wireless module WM-4401-WLS (4 pads) | Replace battery BT-7701-BAT | Solder new WM-4401-WLS, re-pair halves

customer_description: Cursor jumps around randomly, especially on my glass desk. Works fine on mousepad but I prefer using directly on desk.
agent_resolution: Sensor SN-8801-SNS (PAW3395) has issues on reflective surfaces. Recommended mouse pad MP-9901-MPD. Also updated firmware for better surface adaptation.
resolution_steps: Clean sensor lens with microfiber cloth | Use on cloth mouse pad MP-9901-MPD (not glass/reflective) | Update firmware to v1.3+ for improved surface tracking | Lower DPI to 1600 for better stability

customer_description: Left mouse button registering double clicks when I only click once. Very frustrating for drag operations and gaming.
agent_resolution: Omron switch SW-3301-SWT contact bounce. Firmware v1.2+ has software debounce. Advised firmware update first. If hardware fault, RMA for switch replacement.
resolution_steps: Update firmware to v1.4 via manufacturer software | Test left button for double-click | If persistent: initiate RMA for switch SW-3301-SWT replacement | Note: requires soldering, not user-serviceable

customer_description: Teammates can't hear me on Discord. Mic shows as connected but no input. Mute light is off (white).
agent_resolution: Mic boom MB-3301-BM not fully seated - needs firm click. Also verified mic capsule MC-4401-MIC functional. Dongle DG-2201-DGL re-paired.
resolution_steps: Remove and firmly re-insert mic boom MB-3301-BM until click | Verify mute switch shows white (not red) | In Discord/OS: select HEADSET-WL-PRO as input, set volume 80% | Re-pair dongle DG-2201-DGL: hold power 5 seconds
